name: Bayerische Motoren Werke Aktiengesellschaft
blurb: Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW) is a German multinational manufacturer of luxury vehicles and motorcycles. The company operates through automotive, motorcycles, and financial services segments, with a strong global market position in the premium automotive sector. BMW is known for its focus on innovation, including electric mobility and digitalization.
recent: In the past 30 days, BMW reported first-quarter earnings showing cost discipline mitigating margin headwinds and a recovery in cash flow. The stock has seen modest gains, trading around €82.80 as of May 7, 2026, with investors monitoring the transition to electric vehicles and supply chain developments.
